ProceedingsandOrder.Text: SET FOR ARGUMENT on Tuesday, October 7, 2025.

CIRCULATED
Motion for divided argument filed by the Solicitor General GRANTED.

Argued. For petitioner: Matthew B. Larsen, Assistant Federal Defender, New York, N. Y. For respondent in support of petitioner: Aimee Brown, Assistant to the Solicitor General, Department of Justice, Washington, D. C. For Court-appointed amicus curiae in support of judgment below: Charles L. McCloud, Washington, D. C.

Adjudged to be REVERSED IN PART and case REMANDED. Jackson, J., delivered the opinion of the Court with respect to Parts I, II, III, IV-A, and IV-B, and an opinion with respect to Part IV-C, in which Roberts, C. J., and Sotomayor and Kagan, JJ., joined. Gorsuch, J., filed an opinion concurring in part.
Judgment Issued.
